messages:
maria: Heads-up — we need to reserve capacity for the new us-west3 cluster bring-up next week. Target = 40 A100 GPUs (50% reserved for smoke/validation, 50% for initial fleet). Who can own quota requests and a short reservation playbook?

alex: I can own cloud-side quota requests. Quick q: is this GCP-only for now?

maria: Yes, GCP us-west3 for Phase 1. We may mirror to another region later.

katie: Cost check: 40 A100s for 30 days burn = rough estimate in budget? Ping finance afterwards. We should also request a short reservation hold (provider-side) not just quotas.

jin: Copying the minimal steps I used last time — paste into ticket template. Keep the request conservative and ask for a 14-day capacity hold.

jin: ```
Project: redwood-inference-infra
Region: us-west3
Resource: NVIDIA A100 GPU (a100-40gb)
Quantity: 40
Start: 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z
End: 2026-06-15T00:00:00Z
Reason: Cluster bring-up + perf validation + initial provisioning
Contact: alex@redwood.ai
```

alex: Filing the quota ticket now — using provider portal + support escalation. Will add the playbook link and the perf smoke checklist.

procurement-bot: Ticket created (#Q-4521) — support ETA 72 hours. Assigned to GCP-Quota-Team.

maria: We also need a reservation for nodes (not just quota) so the fleet can bootstrap consistently. Jin, can you add the node reservation snippet?

jin: For the node reservation, use this sample gcloud command to request a capacity reservation (if provider supports reservations):

```bash
gcloud compute reservations create usw3-a100-reserve \
  --zone=us-west3-a \
  --accelerator-type=nvidia-tesla-a100 \
  --accelerator-count=40 \
  --keep-unused-resources
```

jin: If provider doesn't allow reservations at that scale, escalate to account rep and ask for temporary capacity commit. Document the fallback policy: if reservation fails, fall back to smaller staged bring-up (20 GPUs) + warm cache.

luis: Network check: ensure VPC peerings and private GCS endpoints are set up before nodes come online. I'll run the preflight and post a checklist.

maria: Preflight checklist (short):
- quota ticket created (#Q-4521)
- reservation request submitted (or account commit)
- dedicated subnet + route rules for us-west3 done
- KMS key and HSM policy available for private deploys
- smoke-runner VM image baked and accessible

alex: Update: support asked for clarifications on start/end times and proof of PO for reservation. I've linked the PO stub. Added note: "Will validate with perf smoke and then handoff to eng-sre for production onboarding."

katie: Finance confirmed PO provisional OK for up to 30 days. Add cost center: INF-PLT-88.

maria: Once quota/reservation is confirmed, we run the bootstrap window: day0 bring-up = 10 GPUs to validate imaging + node agent; day1 = scale to 20 and run perf suite; day2 = full 40 if green. Assign owners below.

alex: Owners: day0 = alex (cloud), jin (image), luis (network). day1 = jin (validation), maria (observability metrics), katie (cost smoke). day2 = eng-sre oncall for handoff.

ops-bot: Reminder — create a temporary alerts channel for bring-up: #bringup-usw3 (created).

maria: Validation commands (short):
- provision node pool: `kubectl apply -f nodepool-usw3.yaml`
- smoke test: `./tools/perf-smoke.sh --region=us-west3 --gpus=10`
- KV-cache sanity: check logs `kubectl logs -l app=kvcache | tail -n 200`

jin: Perf pass criteria: p50 latency < 120ms on 512-token avg, no OOMs, and avg token cost within 10% of baseline. If fails, rollback to staging model and open regression issue.

luis: Network checklist posted: subnets, firewall rules, NAT, private gateway, peering acceptance. I'll post CIDR ranges and the peering request id in the ticket.

alex: Update from support: quota approved for 40 GPUs, reservation hold pending — account rep escalated for capacity commit. ETA 24–48h.

maria: Great. When reservation is confirmed please paste the support response and close the procurement loop. After that, eng-sre will schedule a 2-hour bring-up window and invite oncall.

katie: Also flag cost-optimization during bring-up: enable batching at runtime, start with reduced max-seq to lower token usage for initial smoke.

maria: Final note for handoff doc: include rollback triggers, contact list (alex, jin, luis, maria), and expiration of reservation. I'll draft the one-pager and drop in #bringup-usw3 once done.

alex: Will paste support confirmation here once we get it.

procurement-bot: Update — support updated ticket #Q-4521: reservation hold approved for 14 days. Please confirm start date by replying to ticket.

maria: Confirming start 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z. Thanks everyone — will follow up with the handoff doc in ~2h. :thumbsup:

alex: Got it. Locking calendar for day0 window.

jin: I'll bake the smoke image and upload to the region repo tonight.

luis: Network preflight run in ~30m, will post results.

maria: OK, end state = reservation in place, owners assigned, bring-up window scheduled, handoff doc drafted. Closing thread once support confirmation PDF is uploaded.
